part.text:
The first post in the Following feed is open on its Post detail page. It's Mochi napping in a sunbeam by @whiskers.test. The page shows the post with its "Write your reply" box, and the post has no replies yet.

simctl can't tap, so I got there this way:
- I looked up the post's URI from the local AppView and opened its `bluesky://` link. That triggered an "Open in Bluesky?" prompt I couldn't dismiss.
- The HTTPS link opened Safari with a second prompt, which also couldn't be dismissed.
- I generated a small XCUITest runner in `/private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/opencode/tapper/` that taps "Open" on the system alert. That brought the app forward on the post page.

The status bar shows "Safari" as the back-link label, a side effect of the Safari prompt. The app is otherwise in the expected state.
